item.title: Designing a Distributed LRU Cache at Scale
item.description: Production-grade system design for a distributed LRU cache — sub-millisecond reads, consistent hashing with virtual nodes, etcd topology orchestration, cache-aside fallback, and stampede prevention at 347K peak RPS.
